comment: P8 D3 deploy SPEC — D6 SUCCESSOR (repo-only build; proposal SS6.2, CONTRACTS.md 'Entry + config'). This file authorizes nothing: no upload has been performed from it, the provider secret has not been set by tooling, and GENERATION_HALT remains '1'. Secret VALUES never appear here. P8 D3 deploy SPEC for the production migration surface (cutover plan §S4 as corrected; Rowan plan reviews 6355302486 / 6355404829, D1 sign-off 6355565715). This file authorizes nothing and no upload has been performed from it — D2 (the upload) is a separate Julie-approved gate. Secret VALUES never appear here. Topology: this script OWNS its coordinator class (OpalReaderCoordinatorProd, exported by v2/worker-entry-prod.js) and its OWN Durable Object namespace, created by this script's durable_object_migrations — it never shares the staging script's namespace, and the staging script (opalreader-api-v2, v2/p8/deploy-spec.json) is never re-scoped. D6 SUPERSEDES the base spec's no-queue shape for the v1 queue only in this respect: the NEW v2-dedicated queue opalreader-generation-v2 is bound below (producer + consumer on THIS script); opalreader-generation keeps exactly one consumer (the frozen v1 worker) and stays paused. GENERATION_HALT is 1. There is NO R2_KEY_PREFIX binding — its absence IS the production namespace shape (unprefixed audio/<key>), and the production class refuses to construct its R2 cache if a prefix is ever configured (production_r2_prefix_forbidden), so the shape does not depend on error-free upload metadata. Both secrets are recorded as NAMES ONLY in secret_bindings_required and are deliberately absent from the bindings list: OPALREADER_ACCESS_TOKEN and OPALREADER_MIGRATION_OPERATOR_TOKEN are set by Julie herself at D2 (dashboard / Secure Vault), distinct from each other and from staging's values; while the operator secret is unset, migration commands are unreachable on this surface (503 migration_operator_not_configured). The upload EMISSION derived from this spec conforms to Cloudflare's documented Script Upload metadata schema, enforced locally by tools/validate-prod-envelope.mjs.

do_topology.migration_tag_note: Migration tags are per-script/per-namespace: this v1 is the FIRST migration on the production script's own new namespace and is unrelated to the staging script's v1 tag on its namespace.
do_topology.namespace: this script's own, created by its migration above — distinct from the staging script's namespace; the two scripts share no Durable Object state
do_topology.state_rollback_truth: Deleting this Worker script does NOT necessarily delete a created Durable Object database. Before any import, the production namespace's account instance holds no imported state and is read by no client (an empty, inert store), so a pre-import rollback is: delete the script; any DO storage left behind is empty and inert, and explicitly deleting it is a separate reviewed step. After imports begin, state rollback is unnecessary by design: imported books stay invisible until the global repoint (D5), which is Pages-side with its own rollback.

durable_object_migrations.note: v2 is the second migration tag on THIS script's namespace (v1 created OpalReaderCoordinatorProd). OPEN DEPLOY-GATE QUESTION: a Durable Object class swap does not carry the old class's per-instance SQLite storage to the new class — how the account instance's existing state plane carries into the D6 class must be resolved at the separately authorized deploy gate. This repo-only spec records the target shape and authorizes nothing.

production_r2_namespace.note: Unprefixed production key shape (audio/<cacheKey>.<ext>) in the shared opalreader-storage bucket. Enforced in code, not only here: OpalReaderCoordinatorProd refuses to construct its R2 cache when R2_KEY_PREFIX is set to anything (ProductionR2NamespaceError, code production_r2_prefix_forbidden) before any bucket operation.

queue_consumers.note: Consumer = this script itself (queue handler in v2/worker-entry-prod-d6.js -> /internal/execute). The v1 queue opalreader-generation is NOT a producer or consumer here: it keeps exactly one consumer (the frozen v1 worker) and stays paused, untouched.

queue_producers.note: Producer = the v2 coordinator's outbox drain (d6HostEnv sendGrant), wired ONLY when GENERATION_HALT is '0'. 3 operations per message (write+read+delete); free allowance 10,000 ops/day (PINS.md SS4).

secret_bindings_required.name: OPALREADER_ACCESS_TOKEN
secret_bindings_required.source: Set by Julie herself in the Cloudflare dashboard / Secure Vault at D2 time. Must be a DISTINCT production value; never copied from the v1 or staging scripts by tooling (secret values are unreadable between scripts). Deliberately absent from this spec's bindings and from the upload metadata.

secret_bindings_required.name: OPALREADER_MIGRATION_OPERATOR_TOKEN
secret_bindings_required.source: The operator credential for the migration command types, fenced at the production worker entry exactly as on staging. Set by Julie herself at D2, before any import, to a value DISTINCT from OPALREADER_ACCESS_TOKEN (the entry treats an equal value as not configured). DELIBERATELY UNSET in this spec — while unset, migration commands are unreachable on this surface (fail closed). Never set by tooling from any existing token, and never carried in chat, files, or logs.

secret_bindings_required.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secret_bindings_required.source: The D6 provider secret (proposal SS6.3): set by Julie herself on opalreader-api-v2-prod before arming; agents never read, print, or transmit the value. Existence is verified by binding-NAME presence only. Deliberately absent from this spec's bindings and from the upload metadata — NAME ONLY, never a value.

workers_dev_subdomain.note: A new script's workers.dev subdomain starts disabled via the API; D2 enables it once after upload (a step outside the script upload metadata).

changes: main_module -> v2/worker-entry-prod-d6.js; COORDINATOR class -> OpalReaderCoordinatorProdD6 (migration tag v2; see storage-continuity note in durable_object_migrations).
NEW queue opalreader-generation-v2: this script is sole producer (coordinator outbox drain) and sole consumer (queue handler -> /internal/execute).
GEMINI_API_KEY added to secret_bindings_required BY NAME ONLY (set by Julie herself; never a value in this repo).
GENERATION_HALT remains '1': the D6 build deploys HALTED. Queue delivery enablement is the LAST arming step, separately authorized.

Unchanged: scope production, instance account, unprefixed R2 namespace (fail-closed in code), observability enabled+persisted, both D2 secrets distinct and set by Julie, v1 worker/queue untouched, frozen Shelf bridge untouched.
